Server status page: login (lobby) and game servers are checked separately, and the page is available in all eight languages
Server status is linked in the website's top navigation
Server status: the game server table no longer claims a world per address, which the uploads cannot tell
Europe lists 21 servers per faction: Gauss and Agnita are live
A participant keeps the faction the client sent: the stored server is the uploader's, and matched worlds mix both factions
Each participant is filed under the server he announced himself with, not the uploader's
Each participant is filed under the server he announced himself with, not the uploader's
World bosses upload on their death alone: the client only receives a sliver of the damage of 100+ players, so the 90 % damage share no longer applies to them
World bosses upload on their death alone: the client only receives a sliver of the damage of 100+ players, so the 90 % damage share no longer applies to them
An upload may carry up to 200 participants: a world boss has the whole map on it (106 and 108 on Kashapa and Dartan)
World bosses need the 90 % hit-point share again, like every other boss; the upload log names why a boss is not uploaded
World bosses need the 90 % hit-point share again, like every other boss; the upload log names why a boss is not uploaded
An upload carries up to 300 participants for a world boss and at most 20 for an instance boss
Search needs the exact name: player, legion and opponent lookups no longer match partial names or wildcards
Website and client speak Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese, with game names from the AION 2 client
A boss with a fixed time (the Abyss) follows its schedule in the field boss list, not the last list the player opened on that map

Europe lists 23 and Asia 10 servers per faction after the opening announcements

The Cleric heal Light of Regeneration is counted as healing instead of damage, so Clerics no longer show their group heals as damage dealt
Species knowledge shows the real names of the last open effects (damage boost and tolerance, front and back attack boost and tolerance, status effect resist, endurance penetration)

The client also reads the skill bonuses (e.g. Rift Strike +1) and the god stone of every worn item and the stone amounts that are known (Block, MP, HP), and uploads them; the player page tooltips show them

The client reads the stone slots (stat and tier) and the rolled stats of every worn item, for your own character and for players you inspect, and uploads them; the player page tooltips on the website show them
Species knowledge names for four more effects (critical damage defense, HP increase, PvE damage boost and tolerance)
Player page: item names follow the selected language (de, es, fr, ru)
Player page: icons for the Nuakum, Corrupted Judicator, Demiros and Assassin's armor sets

Player page: names for eleven more species knowledge stats (Cognia attack/accuracy/evasion/block, front defense, Specia power, critical attack and critical damage resist, critical resist, penetration, back critical resist)

Species knowledge shows the real names of eleven more effects (Cognia attack/accuracy/evasion/block, front defense, power, critical attack, critical damage resist, critical resist, penetration, back critical resist)
Search visibility: slimmer sitemap with lastmod for every page, real text headings (Aion 2 DPS Meter) instead of the logo as the only h1

Features page redesigned: a full-width scene with its own generated backdrop for every feature, the client windows tilted on one plane, a jump bar with icons, light and dark theme; footer logo no longer stretched
Home page: slim Toolkit banner with links to Features, Instances and World Bosses, calmer download buttons, clean round emblem
Home page: Top players and Recent activity are the same height with equally tall rows
Home page: banner and cards sit closer together, the stats pill straddles the seam
Features page: the numbered chapter labels (01 · Record …) above each scene are gone
The meter remembers the last used mode (damage, heal, taken, all, all compact) and starts with it again

Pet map: when the game has not reported the player's position (it does so only for some movements), the middle of the monsters around the player stands in, so the map no longer falls back to the question mark after untargeting
Overlay windows (pet map, pet list, pet farming, timetable, hotkey, world boss) no longer show up in Alt+Tab
Own Overlay locked switch for the world boss overlay, the timetable and the pet counter (no longer tied to the pet map's lock)
Species knowledge: names for nine more stat ids (back defense, fera block, natura accuracy/crit, varia crit and the pattern-derived siblings)
World boss settings: the note that the server sends the times only for the map you are on is the first sentence
Website: the World Bosses feature says the server sends the times only for the map you are on, with a fresh picture of the page

Website: the World Bosses feature says the times arrive by themselves and shows the finished settings page
Website: redesigned Features page with a hero, a card row that jumps to each feature and check lists
Website: the new Features page texts in French, Spanish, Russian, Polish, Turkish and Chinese
Website: Features page shows one feature at a time with direct links, a compact header and a new World Bosses section
Pet knowledge: twelve more stats show their real names instead of Stat numbers (attack and defense per species, back attack critical, evasion, seal stone damage and more)

The pet knowledge window in your own profile shows the real stat names (attack and defense per species, back attack critical, evasion, seal stone damage and more) instead of Stat numbers
Interactive map: the list stays empty until something is picked, and the arrow stays centred when the map window is made smaller
Pet list: the five pets that showed a number instead of a name now have one

Website: Features page shows the new Gathering, Timetable and Hotkeys settings and mentions the faction filter and the notifications switch
Website: Features page in French, Spanish, Russian, Polish, Turkish and Chinese; changelog entry

Website: Features page with client pictures, Features link in the header, feedback button next to the theme switch, theme icons always toggle
Hotkey settings: a help tooltip explains the next-mode key; character window: the Arcana tab moved to the end
Gathering page: one line per kind with switchable pills, only the collectibles of the player's own faction (read from the saved character) on the page, the list and the map

Interactive map: Pets and Gathering as sub pages, Od as one source, no greyed-out gather entries; the list shows collectibles too and the map keeps the last known position ("?") while the position is unknown; the overlay lock switch moved to the map page
Website: the download button starts the download at the first click (the app swallowed the link and only a reload downloaded)

Timetable settings: every event kind with a switch for the overlay, a reminder sound (six short sounds) with volume and a test button, and one slider for the minutes before the event; the sounds play even when the overlay is hidden
New settings page Sammeln: every collectible of the game grouped by kind, a switch each (what is on shows on the interactive map); entries with no fixed place on the world maps are greyed out

Eye (hide window): a notice says that the window turns transparent and how to bring it back with the hotkey set in the settings; with 'do not show again' and OK

Hotkeys page in groups (DPS meter, Timetable, Pet map); the timetable and pet map hotkeys moved there from their own pages

Pet map: the monsters really around you (announced by the game) are shown large over the general spawn points, the list prefers their distance (~ = only a spawn point); the position follows the monsters announced while you walk (the server sends none)

Pet progress and levels follow the game's own messages (progress gained, level reached, pet added), so the counter stays right through restarts and level-ups; replays no longer write into the real pet-farm.log
Settings: the pet map hotkey sits on the Pet-Karte page under the map switch
Hotkey for the pet map: switches the map and its list on or off (default Ctrl+Alt+K, changeable in the settings)
Pet counter: two souls dropped at once both count (a soul is told apart by its item instance, not by the time); the log compares the count with the game's pet list at every login and map change
Pet list: a short list ends at its last row (the pulled height is only the maximum while locked)
Saving the settings no longer restarts the capture (it forgot the map, the position and the pets); only a new network adapter does
Pet counter: after the last point of a level the next soul starts the next level (Level 1 25/25 -> Level 2 1/75)
Pet list: the length is the height of the frame (no setting any more); unlocked, it shows sample rows so the field's length can be judged

Pet overlays: scale from any edge (not only the corner) without jitter; the places are no longer overwritten when Settings is saved
Pet list: adjustable length in the settings, the farthest pets are cut off
Pet counter: every soul picked up counts the progress up by one until the game sends the pet list again (login, map change)

Settings: Save applies the settings and keeps the window open
Pet information: the text is centred and the window grows to both sides, so its middle can be found
Pet list: sorted by distance, the nearest pet first

Player rows: the faction emblem replaces the rank number

Pet map: the world map (Verteron, Altgard, the Abyss) around you with the spawn points of the pets you chose, each pet in its own colour, plus a separate list with level, progress and distance; map and list can be moved and scaled on their own (Settings: Pet-Karte, 'Overlay locked' off)
Pet farming overlay: Settings switch 'Overlay locked' - unlocked it can be clicked, dragged and scaled, locked it is click-through
Every participant shows the faction of their server (Elyos and Asmodians never share a server), also where the client did not send one

Pet farming overlay: the level of the pet the targeted monster drops, read from the target plate on screen (off by default); pet list and soul drops from the login and inventory frames; local pet-farm.log
Statistics: the faction icon before each server name, and the difficulty step of the most fought bosses as stars

Player details: skill icons also for fights read back from the history (found by skill name and class)
Character profile like the website: Arcana in their own tab, faction, server and the worn titles in the header, the pet circles above the species tables, species effects coloured by quality

worn titles, pet circles and Daevanion board progress are read from the game and shown on the player profile (titles in the header, pet circles above the species tables, board percentages); the client sends them for your own character and for the character windows of other players you open

first-start wizard that every install sees once after the update (language and the upload options, all off by default: boss upload, own profile, profiles of other players); until it is done nothing is uploaded; new setting to upload the profiles of other players; the server of an upload is named from the game's own table for every server id

website - encounter link previews render a damage / healing / damage-taken picture (/og/encounters/<id>.png), instance backgrounds from the game client (un-squeezed, per-image focus), boss cards for expedition / transcendence / ascension bosses, Nightmare bosses lead back to Nightmare; world boss data (NPC ids, 8 client languages)
